sources.license: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 wand125 (problems/square-lower-bounds/LICENSE; the root LICENSE.md says each folder keeps the licence it was published under). The Lean library the proof builds on is Evan Daniel's, MIT, at evand/square-packing 1718a580. The root README says the work is computer-assisted; the commit names Claude as co-author.
claims: problems/square-lower-bounds/certificates/k2m5_n59_L8/lean/Sqpack/S59Lower.lean states theorem SquarePacking.s59_ge_8 : (8 : ℝ) ≤ minSide 59 and theorem SquarePacking.s59_eq_8 : minSide 59 = 8, with no hypothesis; lean/README.md reports both depending on axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], with no sorry and no native_decide.

The certificate is the mixed cover n59_mixed_cover_8.txt (SHA-256 6f4d2b64f9a88ae49546f05fa28752382f9ebfa8b7f8b6e6c6f1a8e693177e19): 26,308 points and 5,240 segments of [0,8]^2, masses w/10^8, total < 59. Sqpack/S59T/Pts.lean holds it as Lean data, with its D4 invariance and total checked by decide +kernel.

The Lean side is Evan Daniel's mixed-measure checker at evand/square-packing 1718a580e5de2fac7e1a5535e98f11ba447d312e, used unchanged: ZMTreeM.checkM (ZMTreeM.soundM), CovM and le_minSide_mixed (Attain.lean). The D4 fundamental region is cut into 80 x 80 root cells in 290 batches (batches.json); the 43,154 Part files and 290 Roots files are generated by scripts/gen_zmmtree_s59.py and not stored, and SOURCES.sha256 lists the SHA-256 of all 43,444 generated files; Sqpack/S59T/Cov.lean and S59Lower.lean are the built files.

The source reports Lean v4.33.1 on Arm64 Linux: generation 94 CPU-hours, the 43,154 Part files 768 CPU-hours at most 9.8 GB resident each, the Roots files 0.5 CPU-hours, Cov.lean 13 s and S59Lower.lean 8 s at 35 GB resident each; receipts/kernel_tasks.jsonl.gz has one line per task with its CPU seconds and peak memory, every task returning 0. lean/README.md also names receipts/final_build.log, which is not in the tree at the pin.
